visible_export_labels: Component tables from an immutable board snapshot.

Populated components only; requires explicit mounting, local centroid and orientation marker. Global origin, X right/Y up, CCW common top view. Bottom reflects the local marker (r+180−marker); this generic convention is not a universal vendor zero.
Included references: 1–64 ASCII letters/digits/underscores, starting with a letter; case collisions are rejected. A separate placement file must use this same populated subset.
Default: a NEW file is required. The active native project is always protected.
At most 100000 source components, 2 MiB aggregate text and 32 MiB CSV. Identifiers and calibration are explicit user input; no stock lookup or manufacturer verification.
